notes: Eclipse Loop 2.4.0 Meter changes inside a song, a stem pitch editor that edits timing and formants as well as pitch, per-note expression, and three pitch-shifting bugs that had been quietly doing nothing. Meter changes The time signature used to be one setting for the whole project. Right-click the ruler at the bar it should change on and pick Meter from bar N — 4/4, 3/4, 6/8, 5/4, 7/8 or 12/8. It holds until the next change, leaves every bar before it exactly as it was, and is drawn on the timeline labelled with the signature so you can find it again. Right-click it to remove it. Bars are re-timed, not renumbered: a clip at bar 9 is still at bar 9 after you drop a 3/4 section in front of it. What changes is how long those bars take, so at 120 BPM a 4/4 bar is 2 seconds and a 3/4 bar is 1.5. The grid, the beat lines, the playhead and playback all follow, and meter changes ripple correctly when you insert or delete time
